The plate spans about 360 px in the image, so I treated it as a side plate of roughly 20-22 cm. That gives about 17 px per cm.

The squash pile covers roughly 220 px by 230 px, or about 13 cm by 13 cm. The pieces are irregular and sparse, and the pile is about 2-3 cm high. I counted about 6 chunks, each roughly 5 cm by 3 cm by 2.5 cm, or about 35 g each. That comes to around 200 g, which I lowered to about 180 g because the pieces overlap and have gaps.

I also saw a few white spots that look like cheese or feta crumbles. I put these at about 8 g.

The squash looks roasted with oil, so I counted a small amount of oil separately at about 5 g.
